original.text: bhavabījāṅkurajananā rāgādyāḥ kṣayam upāgatā yasya / brahmā vā viṣṇur vā haro jino vā namas tasmai
original.edition: recalled by the unit author (wording believed standard; to be checked against an edition)

paraphrase: Homage to him in whom attachment and the other [passions], which make the sprout of the seed of rebirth grow, have been destroyed — whether he be Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Hara or the Jina.
notes: Ascription to Hemacandra and the verse number are traditional/uncertain; the verse is widely quoted.
